tests.name: Trap EXIT
tests.description:
Launch bash shell with command arg to create TRAP on EXIT.
The trap executes script that writes to /tmp/art-fish.txt

tests.name: Trap EXIT (freebsd)
tests.description:
Launch bash shell with command arg to create TRAP on EXIT.
The trap executes script that writes to /tmp/art-fish.txt

tests.name: Trap SIGINT
tests.description:
Launch bash shell with command arg to create TRAP on SIGINT (CTRL+C), then send SIGINT signal.
The trap executes script that writes to /tmp/art-fish.txt

tests.name: Trap SIGINT (freebsd)
tests.description:
Launch bash shell with command arg to create TRAP on SIGINT (CTRL+C), then send SIGINT signal.
The trap executes script that writes to /tmp/art-fish.txt

tests.name: Trap DEBUG - Log All Shell Commands
tests.description:
Launch bash shell with command arg to create TRAP on DEBUG.
The trap logs executed commands to /tmp/art-fish.txt, simulating persistent command interception.
